title: 3 levels of "sorry" in Korean 🙇 미안 · 미안해요 · 죄송합니다 #learnkorean
caption:
미안 (mi-an) — sorry. Friends only.
미안해요 (mi-an-hae-yo) — I'm sorry. Polite.
죄송합니다 (joe-song-ham-ni-da) — I'm very sorry. For teachers, bosses and anyone older.

전하 (jeon-ha) = Your Majesty. Palace dramas only. Please don't try it on your teacher.

SYNK LAB
#learnkorean #studykorean #koreanlanguage #koreanphrases
pinnedComment: Which level for your teacher — 1, 2 or 3? 👇
alt: A needle-felted school hallway. A coral felt ghost mascot crashes into a teacher doll and coffee explodes across the frame. The mascot apologises in three rising levels — 미안 (friends only), 미안해요 (polite), 죄송합니다 (for teachers) — then in an imagined palace drama it kowtows to the teacher as king (전하! 죄송합니다!), then an endless line of mascots carries coffee to the teacher, buried in a mountain of cups. At 근데… every copy stops crying and glares; they accuse her (네가 부딪쳤잖아!), and the mascot sits crowned on a throne while the teacher serves it coffee. A replay of the crash shows the mascot did it, the teacher stares, and one tiny flattened mascot whispers 죄송합니다.
